questions.prompt: After compaction, the surface is 0, 1, 74, 58 ... 71. Where are events 2 to 57?
options: Deleted from the log to save space
Still in the log, hidden from the model by the replace instruction at seq 74
Moved to the end of the surface
questions.explanation: Nothing is deleted. deriveSurface reads seq 74's replace instruction and shows it in place of 2 to 57, while the log keeps every event.

questions.prompt: The process crashes right after compaction/start is written. What does the log show on resume?
options: A finished compaction with no summary
Nothing unusual, because compaction/start is not saved
A start with no matching end, so you can tell compaction never finished
The summary, because it was written first
questions.explanation: The lock is released last. A start without an end marks an unfinished attempt instead of falsely claiming success.

questions.prompt: Why does deriveSurface find startSeq and endSeq by position on the current surface instead of treating them as a numeric range?
options: After an earlier replace, some events inside the range are already hidden, so the range is a span of what is visible
Because positions are faster to compare than numbers
Because compaction records are counted in the range
questions.explanation: An older summary may already stand in for some events. The replace covers whatever is visible between the two ends.
